analysis:
Examined all supplied metadata, patches and source excerpts. These units change documentation only; no independently supported security regression was identified. docs/architecture/README.md:25 adds a local-control link. changelog.d/provider-addon-hold-hardening.md:3–15 and docs/architecture/addon-hold.md:40–45,70–96,105–110 describe load/publication fencing, release-safe cancellation, preload-record preservation, verification before socket-slot allocation, request deadlines and nonblocking file reads. The inference.md patch adds the matching 503 explanation at head line 2555. These behaviors principally affect A-018, TB-012/T-059 and TB-007/T-010; unchanged surrounding text keeps App Attest recovery and reconnect admission separate (addon-hold.md:59–65). No changed encryption, tenant-cache scoping, billing, credential or serving-authorization policy is evidenced here.
Integration must verify the documented controls in AddonIPCServer.swift, AddonHoldStore.swift, AddonHoldControl.swift, ProviderLoop+AddonHold.swift, ProviderLoop+ModelLoading.swift, native MiMo/Super publication paths and ProviderLoop+StartupPreload.swift. In particular, check cancellation snapshot identity across release/re-hold, local-request retirement before unload, and whether waiting past the 60-second settle allowance (addon-hold.md:42–43) remains responsive to release/stop and cannot strand availability on a stuck load. The existing retirement-fault behavior at line 107 is not new. Socket authentication placement and FIFO refusal are claims, not verified implementation in this batch. Runtime source and the linked local-control document are outside the supplied scope, so these material contracts remain for integration rather than findings.
